claims.text: Intake documents active suicidal ideation with plan and intent.
Intake records a stated plan to overdose and intent to act.
Intake documents a preparatory act in the past week.
Intake assessment records high acute risk.
Day 1 progress note documents active suicidal ideation with plan and intent uncertain.
Intake and the day 1 progress note describe intent differently. This difference is documented and is not resolved in this packet.
Patient was admitted to inpatient psychiatry on close observation.
Day 2 progress note documents suicidal ideation with plan and denial of current intent on the unit.
Observation was stepped down to every 15 minutes on day 2.
Day 3 progress note documents passive suicidal ideation without plan.
Day 3 assessment rates risk as moderate and cites a recent preparatory act, ambivalence about safety after discharge, and living alone.
Intake describes two weeks of worsening depressed mood after job loss.
Day 2 progress note describes suicidal thoughts as quieter but still present.
Day 3 progress note documents depressed mood with slightly brighter affect.
Sleep was recorded as 3 hours on day 1 and 5 hours on day 3.
Meal intake was recorded as 25% on day 1 and 50% on day 3.
Intake records insight and judgment as poor.
Day 3 progress note records limited future orientation.
Intake lists hypothyroidism as treated.
Patient refused the evening sertraline dose on day 2, citing nausea.
Intake documents alcohol use of 2 to 3 beers on weekends and denies other drugs.
Patient attended 1 group on day 2.
Patient attended 2 of 4 groups on day 3.
Intake documents one prior inpatient admission in 2021 for suicidal ideation.
Intake documents that outpatient therapy stopped in July 2026 after an insurance change.
Intake documents nonadherence to prescribed sertraline for six weeks before admission.
Intake documents that the patient lives alone in an apartment.
Intake documents that the patient's sibling lives 40 minutes away.
Day 3 progress note states the family meeting has not been held and is scheduled for November 4.
The initial treatment plan records the discharge plan as to be determined.
Day 3 progress note states discharge planning has begun and considers a partial hospitalization program after discharge.
The record shows a discharge plan recorded as to be determined on the initial plan and discharge planning noted as begun on day 3. The documented discharge pathway is not yet defined.

openQuestions: Intent is documented differently: intake records a plan to overdose and intent to act, while the day 1 progress note records intent uncertain. Clinician to review; not resolved here.
Discharge plan is documented as to be determined on the initial treatment plan, and day 3 notes discharge planning has begun. Clinician to confirm the current discharge plan and criteria.
The concurrent review request is a draft with no documented submission or decision. Clinician to confirm its status.
The initial treatment plan (version 1, 2026-11-01) has no documented update and no signature. Clinician to confirm whether a current signed plan exists.
The day 2 progress note is a late entry signed November 3 with no original entry time documented. Clinician to confirm when day 2 status was documented.

Sertraline dosing is documented differently across records: intake lists prescribed 100 mg, the treatment plan says restart 50 mg, day 1 says 50 mg started, and day 3 says increase to 100 mg. Clinician to confirm the current order.
Day 2 plan to address medication side effects does not specify the intervention or any dose change. Clinician to clarify.
No structured risk instrument is repeated after intake, and the safety plan exists only as a first draft on 2026-11-02. Current risk status and safety planning progress are not fully documented.
Family meeting has not been held as of day 3, and the sibling is unavailable until November 4. Home support plan is undocumented.
